employer.name: Liffey Precision Components Ltd
employer.address: Unit 4, Ballymount Business Park, Dublin 24, D24 X2Y3

job.title: Quality technician
job.description: Inspection of machined valve components and keeping the quality records.

probation.conditions: Reviewed with the employee at three and at six months

pay.method: credit transfer to the employee's bank account
pay.overtime_rate: one and a half times the hourly rate for hours over 39 in a week

hours.standard: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:18, with an unpaid 30-minute lunch break
hours.overtime: only at the employer's request, paid at the overtime rate above

leave: 20 working days of annual leave a year and the public holidays, under the Organisation of Working Time Act 1997
sickness: Statutory sick pay under the Sick Leave Act 2022 as in force, and company sick pay at full pay for up to ten working days a year on a medical certificate
pension: No occupational pension scheme; the employer contributes to the automatic enrolment retirement savings system for eligible employees
termination: Notice under the Minimum Notice and Terms of Employment Act 1973: one week from either side in the first two years of service, the employer's notice rising with service
training: Induction and quality-system training in the first month, as paid working time
social_security: The Department of Social Protection's Social Insurance Fund (PRSI, collected by Revenue)
